title: GOTCHA structured rules
description: Machine-queryable representation of src/gotcha.md, generated by scripts/build-structured-rules.sh. Each rule is an addressable record derived from a single source bullet.

schema.description: Artifact schema version. Bump on any breaking shape change.

source.description: Repo-relative path the rules were parsed from.

rule_count.description: Number of entries in rules; equals rules.length.

section.description: Source h2 heading the rule lives under.

subsection.description: Source h3 heading, or null when the rule sits directly under the h2.

type.description: Rule class, derived from the nearest heading.

severity.description: Enforcement weight; hard-stop rules are critical.

tags.description: Section and subsection slugs for filtering.

text.description: Verbatim rule text (bullet marker stripped; nested bullets folded with ' — ').
